'''Bloom Fruit''' was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] regarded by the [[Witches of Dathomir]] for its ability to heighten senses when consumed. [[Herbalist/Legends|Herbalists]] of the witch clans further enhanced this effect by drying and preparing the fruit.
